import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

output = pathlib.Path("parsimony_percentages.tsv")
with output.open("w") as out:
    out.write("group\tfile\tpis\ttotal\tpercentage\n")
    for group, zip_path in [("animals", pathlib.Path("$(inputs.animals_zip.path)")),
                            ("fungi", pathlib.Path("$(inputs.fungi_zip.path)"))]:
        zf = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path)
        members = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".mafft"))
        for member in members:
            zf.extract(member, path="work")
            aln = pathlib.Path("work") / member
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(aln)],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
            )
            fields = proc.stdout.strip().split("\t")
            if len(fields) != 3:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected PhyKIT output for {member}: {proc.stdout!r}")
            out.write(f"{group}\t{member}\t{fields[0]}\t{fields[1]}\t{fields[2]}\n")
        zf.close()

import subprocess

import zipfile

output = pathlib.Path("parsimony_percentages.tsv")
with output.open("w") as out:
    out.write("group\tfile\tpis\ttotal\tpercentage\n")
    for group, zip_path in [("animals", pathlib.Path("/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79181478/inputs/dataset_8b4b72ea-0eeb-4bac-8c9d-fe8981e98bc5.dat")),

        zf = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path)
        members = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith(".mafft"))
        for member in members:
            zf.extract(member, path="work")
            aln = pathlib.Path("work") / member
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(aln)],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
            )
            fields = proc.stdout.strip().split("\t")
            if len(fields) != 3:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected PhyKIT output for {member}: {proc.stdout!r}")
            out.write(f"{group}\t{member}\t{fields[0]}\t{fields[1]}\t{fields[2]}\n")
        zf.close()
